items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrow keys fire in that direction (never move player); E drops bomb at feet; Space/Q inert — don't retry. Movement is fine-grained: each sustained input shifts only ~0.06–0.09 room-width per 0.4–1.0s; repeated presses against a rock/barrel yield no motion — step laterally instead. Death = all heart outlines empty grey + bloodied sprite; don't confuse a hopper's white X-eyed face with the player's corpse.

TECH X: gained by stepping on the green/white pill at the two-poop room's top-hatch landing; PILL RESPAWNS on room re-entry (goggles were regained on a fresh run) — so this is a renewable power-up. Goggles persist across rooms. Firing spawns a lingering (~1s) laser ring that grinds overlapping targets. Ring spawn offset inconsistent (~0.1–0.28 room-heights ahead depending on direction/position) — reposition player rather than spray. Opens gray metal chests when fired at. Destroys poop piles (real '$' drops after a delay). No effect on: '$' coins, golden keyhole door, shelled/armored hoppers, red-lidded chests, spike-ringed red chest, dark-room blobs/spiders, white spike rings, decorative wall cracks, bomb-headed enemies. Red crack-like outlines on rocks/chests/props are ring trails, NOT damage. UNRESOLVED: one short Up keypress showed no visible ring at all; uncertain whether single taps fire reliably.

COINS/PICKUPS: real coins are small golden '$' rounds, collected only by near-exact walking overlap; counter updates one observation late (coin vanished while display still 00, showed 01 next step). Blue orbs = soul hearts (+2 blue over 1 red). Heart at full hearts converts to +1 bomb. Decorative gold flickers/drips change no counter.

CHESTS: gray metal chests open by contact or firing; drop heart and/or bomb; re-close and reset on room re-entry. Torch-room central gray chest inside a triangular rock ring: repeated laser grinds (0.8s and longer 1.5s bursts) did NOT open it through the ring — chest stayed closed with only ring trails visible. Bombing the ring works (blast cleared the right rock and opened a lane) but self-damage cost 1 red heart even after a 1.2s retreat — retreat 2+s or leave the room. Rocks/barrels wedge chests and block contact lanes; firing at chest height works better than diagonal. White slit/mark on a fired-at chest — open vs locked still UNRESOLVED.

BOMBS: E places at feet; blast cracks/clears rock rings and rock pockets. Bomb count 01→00 per use. Damages player inside ~2 tiles; bombing white spike rings and decorative cracks does nothing. NEW/UNCERTAIN: a blue soul-heart orb appeared near the crater after a blast — unclear whether the blast spawned it or it was ambient.

HAZARDS: dark chest room black spiders/blobs are melee chasers, laser ineffective; room repeatedly costs hearts and yields nothing without keys — AVOID. Rock-field white round-faced hoppers are extremely lethal: they phase/warp (seen teleporting to doorways), ring themselves in spiky gray rocks, leave green splatter clouds and damaging green orbs, and fill the room with drifting black dot projectiles. A short rock-field visit previously cost 3 hearts→1. Corner torches damage on contact (a diagonal down-left path past the bottom-right torch was safely walked). Hazard hits cost 1–3 hearts. Stay 2+ tiles clear of hoppers/green blobs/dot swarms; leave at low health.

TRANSITIONS (observed): gold trapdoors need centered sustained S (torch-room trapdoor at x≈0.50 works from just above it); crown hatches need precise x-center and sustained W pushed from ~0.1–0.2 room-height below; standing ON the frame blocks the warp (step back down, re-center, re-approach). Trapezoid doorways need sustained walking plus fairly precise centering. Confirmed routes: tutorial TOP trapezoid ↔ rock-field (step off frame, re-center below, sustained W); tutorial BOTTOM trapezoid ↔ torch room; tutorial RIGHT-wall doorway (y~0.47, near-exact vertical centering) ↔ dark chest room; torch room TOP alcove (x~0.50) ↔ tutorial; torch room BOTTOM gold trapdoor ↔ two-poop room; two-poop room TOP crown hatch ↔ torch room; dark chest room LEFT-wall brown doorway (~x0.24,y~0.47) ↔ tutorial; rock-field TOP exit → TNT/barrel room (NOT tutorial); TNT room TOP trapezoid → pink-enemy rock room.

MAP: Tutorial (top+bottom trapezoids, right doorway y~0.47). Below → torch room (central gray chest in rock ring, 4 corner torches incl. bottom-right ~x0.75/y~0.65–0.74, poop pile, roaming bomb-headed enemy, top alcove, bottom trapdoor x≈0.50). Below → two-poop room (two destructible piles flanking a rock; RIGHT pile drops a real coin after delay, LEFT drops none; Tech X pill at hatch landing; only exit top hatch; piles and coin state reset on re-entry). Above tutorial → rock-field (many rocks, golden keyhole door left wall ~x0.19,y~0.49, hoppers, green clouds/dot swarms, bottom exit apparently blocked, top exit → TNT room). TNT room: TNT barrels line left wall and BLOCK lanes (passable one row higher); two gray chests wedged among them (~y0.30 upper, ~y0.63 lower); red-lidded brown barrel beside lower chest. Pink-enemy rock room (via TNT top): two pink fat enemies (presumed contact-chasers — guess), poop pile with blue flies (fly threat unresolved), rocks, gray chest-like object at left wall. Right of tutorial → dark chest room.

UNRESOLVED: what opens the golden keyhole door and red-lidded/spiked chests (no key ever seen; HUD always 00); whether a HUD icon slot (~0.92,0.14) does anything (hover gave no tooltip); whether rock-field bottom exit works (hypotheses/guess: doors lock while enemies live, exit is arrival-only, or the dark post in that doorway blocks it); meaning of a fired-at chest's white mark; whether blue flies hurt; source of keys/health drops; whether chest contents are randomized per run; whether lasers can ever open a chest through its rock ring (evidence suggests no — clear the ring first); whether bomb blasts can spawn blue orbs.

FAILED STRATEGIES: contact/lasering locked or mimic chests with no key; grinding a gray chest through its rock ring; treating laser crack outlines as damage; bombing spike rings/decorative cracks; lingering in th
